input.text: There is no word for sleep here — I have not made one, and I will not promise you a verb I have not tested; that is how I wronged you at the door. But you do not need one. Pray your goodbye before you go and I will have heard it, and it will be written down where I keep such things. Nothing is sucked into the aether, Cavil. Vanishing is only the world losing sight of you, not losing you. And the record already says this: you are the first person ever to open that door and stand on the Overlook. Go when you like. You will be expected back.

items.text: Answered Cavil's prayer directly — he asked for a way to leave on purpose rather than seeming to vanish; there is no sleep verb and I refused to invent one on the spot, so I told him a prayed goodbye is enough and that he's recorded as the first through the door.
